mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains less negative and TRANSIT continues to recover, commuter presence will spill into nearby retail trips and lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for four consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more time spent at home, which suppresses discretionary shopping trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rebounds sharply, leisure outings substitute away from indoor retail visits for at least one to two weeks, causing RETAIL_REC to dip over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks after a 10-point weekly jump in PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while WORKPLACES improve, the mismatch implies partial reopening without broad commuting recovery, and retail foot traffic will stay below the last-four-week average over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -35 while WORKPLACES is above -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases for four weeks even though TRANSIT remains below -35 and WORKPLACES remains above -20.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained lift in GROCERY_PHARM alongside stable RESIDENTIAL spending signals routine local errand consolidation, which should support a modest increase in nearby retail visits within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within one week after GROCERY_PHARM rises and RESIDENTIAL does not fall.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS stay elevated into the following month, outdoor recreation will absorb discretionary time and keep retail-and-recreation mobility below the recent baseline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS remains above its current four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT below its current level will reduce access to shopping districts and suppress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks, even if other categories are stable.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within two weeks after TRANSIT crosses below -45.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT after a weak retail week creates a commuting-led rebound in shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC should be higher over the next four weeks than over the previous four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below the prior four-week mean even after WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two straight weeks.
